title: Azure Overview
description: The Azure services ObserveCraft collects from Azure Monitor: virtual machines, SQL databases, App Service, load balancers and storage.

definition.content: A starting point for the Azure services ObserveCraft collects from Azure Monitor. Add app registrations in [Integrations → Microsoft Azure](/integrations/azure); every chart filters by subscription, resource group and region.
Virtual machines: CPU, memory, disks and network.
High CPU can be normal; CPU pinned at its maximum slows the VM.
SQL databases: connections, CPU, DTU and storage.
DTU consumption near 100% means the database needs a larger tier or lighter queries.
Web apps and function apps: requests, errors, response time and executions.
Load balancers: data path and health probe availability, traffic.
Data path availability below 100% means the frontend IP isn’t reachable; health probe status, that backends fail their probes.
Storage accounts: availability, capacity, transactions and latency.
